tools.name: get_contact

tools.name: get_services

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Return the legal identity of the entity. Relevant when a contract, invoice or other document must name the company exactly.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_contact" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return the only contact channel for ARCLERA DIGITAL, LLC. Relevant when a user asks how to reach Arclera." → after: "Return the only contact channel for Arclera Digital. Relevant when a user asks how to reach Arclera."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
